name: Bellows Hearth
core_rationale: Central chimney-guild town of The Gilded Exhaust Flues at [1, 1] built around Krono's primary brass exhaust bellows where sweeps roast chestnuts and guard the Ash-Valve Vault.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Warm copper condenser troughs fed by condensed golden flue steam

North.lock_message: Scalding golden exhaust plumes vent through the Cinder Chimney Damper; the Bellows Guild requires the Master Damper Crank from Ash-Valve Vault before opening the northern flue.

resident_npcs.name: Master Sweep Pippin
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Mind your boots on the warm brass grates, Sprout! Our 0.60 meter chestnut-roasting counters are warmed directly by Krono's deep furnace breath.

resident_npcs.name: Valve-Tinker Mira
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: A rogue furnace-automaton down in the Ash-Valve Vault jammed the Master Damper Crank. Retrieve it so we can vent the northern Cinder Chimney!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors The Gilded Exhaust Flues at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Ash-Valve Vault.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A cozy brass chimney-town where giant accordion bellows puff golden mist and warm chestnut ovens.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Counters at 0.58 to 0.60m, grate stair risers at 0.15m, doorways 2.15m x 1.65m, and 13.0m avenues for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-flue-causeway, Dungeon portal to dungeon-ash-valve-vault, and North fog_of_lore portal to hunting-area-cinder-chimney.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Cinder Chimney Damper behind a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Bellows Guild lock message.
